scope: Read-only review of scripts/cu66-v110/canonical.py, scripts/cu66-v110/native.py, fpga/experiments/cu66-v110-flow run/report Tcl and runner, plus study-policy.json. No flow or RTL run executed for this review.

canonical.baseline: Actual V109 FETCH native receipt and its pinned canonical Q result; checks receipt/input manifest, fixed 10 ns clock loaded before synthesis, V109 source origins and baseline receipt/result identity.
canonical.current_origin_binding: All 18 baseline source origins are checked against recorded hashes. V110 busy/fault overrides are explicit and each must have a matching PASS actual focused receipt hash. Unchanged V107 bench/packaging and admission source remain bound to the frozen V109 record.
canonical.functional_guard: Uses Verilator --assert and -Wall, no DNDEBUG; rejects compiler warnings; requires candidate PASS rows to match frozen V109 control stdout and raw event/canonical artifact hashes per seed.
canonical.count_guard: Candidate profile/directed counters increment only after each candidate seed passes. Baseline V109 RTL is explicitly reused, not recompiled or recounted.
canonical.current_q_state: Busy and combined Q processes had partial candidate output but no final receipt at audit; they are not counted as passes.
canonical.snapshots: The canonical script in each active busy and combined attempt source snapshot matches the current script SHA.

native_gate.source_contract: Requires a PASS actual canonical result, 18 source closure entries including 17 SV files and one header, current origin hashes, and applicable focused proof hashes.
native_gate.baseline_clock: Pins V109 FETCH receipt/input manifest and 10 ns actual pre-synthesis clock-loaded evidence.
native_gate.preflight_binding: Requires policy, prepared inputs, source contract, tool, and recipe hashes to match an independent PASS_V110_NATIVE_PREFLIGHT_AUDIT record before dispatch.
native_gate.resource_and_repeat_controls: Policy limits initial trials to three variants, at most two concurrent heavy jobs, 2 CPUs/8 GiB/2400 s; permits two hypothesis-led adaptive trials and one clean positive RTL repeat. Silent retries are rejected.
native_gate.report_parser: Runner enforces exact 10 ns clock waveform, setup/hold/pulse, check_timing, and route-status predicates; root reports parser self-test matched all four actual V109 report sets. The V110 launcher also checks V109 FETCH reports parse identically to the pinned receipt before preparing a trial.
native_gate.local_predicate_mapping: Flow report emits read-only local-predicates TSV for busy_owned/fault_pending/fault_ack cells with primitive/location/INIT where available; no KEEP or DONT_TOUCH is applied.
native_gate.scope: OOC component route only. Runner hard-codes board I/O, complete top, hardware 30 fps and under-10-ms qualification false; physical pass still requires a fresh RTL repeat.
